title: Fitness Life magazine has received high praise from FITNESS NZ, who have voted it the best health and fitness publication in the southern hemisphere..
html:
Great job Tania and Mark!

Fitness Life Magazine have just received a fantastic endorsement from Fitness New Zealand. I have known the people (Tania and Mark) behind this magazine for sometime now and this is a great testament to how hard they work to promote the fitness industry and healthy living.

Read the endorsement here
